name: The Course at Aberdeen
architects: Dr. Michael Hurdzan (1997; the club's site); third-party listings (GolfPass, golfn) credit Jack Kidwell, Hurdzan's partner in Kidwell & Hurdzan

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM, project IN_Indiana_Statewide_LiDAR_2017_B17 (tiles x48y459 and x49y459, published 2021-07-04), mosaicked and clipped to the world + 100 m by data/aberdeen/clip_dem.py; EPSG:26916 (NAD83 / UTM 16N), NAVD88 metres; fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-10-31 (release data-aberdeen)

laz.source: USGS 3DEP lidar point cloud, project IN_Indiana_Statewide_LiDAR_2017_B17 (work unit IN_Statewide_Opt2_B1_2017, QL2), tiles in2018_29402250, in2018_29402255, in2018_29452250 and in2018_29452255; NAD83(HARN) / Indiana West (US ft), NAVD88 US ft; classes 1, 2, 7, 9, 10, 17, 18 delivered, no vegetation classes, so trees come from class 1 with roofs dropped by roof_last_share (as at Wannamoisett and Newport); fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-10-31 (release data-aberdeen), each tile clipped to the world + 100 m with pipeline/intake.py laz
laz.label: 2017-2018 USGS Indiana statewide lidar, leaf-off

world.note: OSM course boundary (relation 15570452) bbox 1,668 x 1,356 m in EPSG:32616 + scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred: 2,048 m east-west (190 m each side; the 2,048 m limit), 1,792 m north-south (218 m each side)

scorecard_source: GolfingRecord (golfingrecord.com/golf-scorecard/24964743-0f86-4ac0-9d4d-37e5969a2378), retrieved 2026-10-31; unverified third-party listing (the club's site, golfataberdeen.com/course, says four sets of tees and has no card). Its Black, Gold, Green and White rows add up to the rated totals (6,917 / 6,573 / 6,151 / 4,949). Conflicts: GolfPass and 18Birdies give Black 12 as 406 (total 6,905) and GolfPass Gold 6 as 146 and 18 as 379 (total 6,543, against its own tee table's 6,573); GolfPass and 18Birdies also list a Blue tee (5,670 yd, 67.0/116) and combination tees that the club's four sets don't include. Ratings: Black, Gold, Green men's (all sources agree); White men's 64.4/105 from 18Birdies (68.3/120 is the women's rating). Stroke index: the men's row (all sources agree). Built from Black and Gold (developer's overnight call: the back tees and the set in front of them when there is no Blue; course chat's reading that the club has no Blue tee).
tree_type_note: course chat 2026-10-31: the leaf-off QL2 lidar can't tell needle from broadleaf here: the last-return shares are one broad hump (an Otsu split called half the woods pines) and leaf-off crowns are thin, so the crown-shape rule calls 59 % conifers. The course is an oak-maple-cottonwood hardwood parkland (club: tree-lined fairways); the theme draws the broadleaves as bur oak, sugar maple and silver maple/cottonwood. The few planted spruces by the houses are lost
attribution: Elevation and trees: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (2017-2018 Indiana statewide lidar)
notes: Overnight build 2026-10-30/31 without the developer (calls logged in validation_report.md and docs/courses/aberdeen.md). Wind 2-10 mph is the course chat's call: no standing band for the Midwest; open, flat inland northwest Indiana 15 km from Lake Michigan, a little windier than inland New England (1-9), like the tidal-river band (2-10).
